market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After 4 of 22 races, Russell sits 2nd with 80 points, 20 behind teammate Antonelli (100). Mercedes appears dominant in 2026 regulations. With ~18 races remaining and a 20-point deficit primarily to a single rival in same car, Russell has a real but not majority chance. Base rate for a #2 driver in points to win is ~25-30% historically; teammate situation lowers slightly.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Antonelli's early-season form is sustainable and whether Mercedes maintains constructors edge
